snip.t: The Meninges: Dura mater (outer, tough fibrous layer), arachnoid mater (avascular middle mesh), and pia mater (vascular inner layer adherent to brain surface).

Dura mater & venous sinuses: Major pathways for CSF absorption and venous drainage; thrombosis impairs outflow

qs.q: A 68-year-old man undergoes a neurosurgical procedure involving the removal of a meningioma overlying the frontal convexity. Upon incising the dura mater, what is the predominant histological component encountered immediately deep to this layer?
qs.e: The superficial layer of the cerebral cortex is composed of grey matter, which consists primarily of neuronal cell bodies. Myelinated white matter tracts are located deeper beneath the cortical grey matter.
